adaptations.rationale: Preserves the frozen Grok 0.18 React renderer structure while adapting shipping Fabushi contracts only: browser-login status application is monotonic so a late logging-in acknowledgement cannot overwrite a newer logged-in observation; the root exposes stable Agent-shell markers used by product parity acceptance; empty sidebar-section records fall back to Grok visible-Agent ordering; and complete-roster reconciliation settles an unselected account on the first visible Agent. These adaptations also publish the live sidebar width to the shell so the recovered WindowChrome drag carrier does not overlap Fabushi Agent header controls; the sidebar header remains the local drag surface and its controls are explicit no-drag regions. They keep authentication real through cursorAccount.login/getStatus and keep roster/selection state on the production Coordinator path rather than introducing a parallel renderer. It also preserves optimistic user-message text and committed attachment metadata while correlated authoritative message/attachment echoes settle, so the live transcript does not drop attachment chips between send acceptance and durable echo.

Keeps Grok 0.18 Agent projection/filter/sort semantics while accepting the shipping Mahayana Coordinator agents event envelope { agents: [...] } in addition to the frozen direct array form. The adaptation is limited to transport normalization at the renderer projection boundary; Agent identity, hidden state, activity and ordering continue through the frozen Grok projection logic. It also normalizes authoritative Mahayana transcript echoes that carry Grok attachment contexts on user messages, preserving committed path/name/MIME/size metadata for mixed and attachment-only sends without relying on optimistic renderer state.
